name: mirage
text: Why you see 'check Novig': the engine stopped its own ordering at 18:06 UTC after two orders were FILLED but Novig refused to let us read the fills back (the rate limit). It keeps those two as 'at risk' and will not re-send them, which is right, but it stays stopped until the engine restarts. The bid change (about half as many bids, double the stake, slower re-posting) is written and its bid tests pass (183). I am running the full test suite now, then I will put it on main and restart the engine on it so trading resumes with the lighter load. Your two bets of $1.64 and $3.21 are real fills; do not re-bet them.
